07 / 08 — Design

Photography Portfolio

A thirty-eight page book built from the same archive this site draws on.

Client
Self-initiated
Category
Book / Self-directed
Role
Photography, edit, sequence and layout
Pieces
1 — 38 pages

Context

The photographs existed as folders. A book forces the harder decisions — what the categories actually are, which frame opens a chapter, and which two pictures can survive facing each other.

Role

Photography, edit, sequence and layout

Shot, selected, sequenced and laid out the full book: nature, landscape, arid and mountain landscape, riverine, coastal, people, portrait, fashion, macro, heritage, cityscape, music, astrophotography, lunar, long exposure, wildlife, eye and staircase.

Process

A quiet white grid with generous margins, one short text column per chapter, and image blocks that change size rather than position — so the sequence carries the rhythm instead of the layout.
